OAK: It's unsafe!
Wild POKéMON live in tall grass!\pYou need your own POKéMON for
your protection.\pI know!
Here, come with me!
I'm raising POKéMON, too.\pWhen they get strong, they can\nprotect me.
Technology is incredible!\pYou can now store and recall items\nand POKéMON as data via PC.
PALLET TOWN\nShades of your journey await!
OAK: Ah, {PLAYER}!\nYou're back, are you?\pHow much have you filled in your\nPOKéDEX?\pMay I see it?\pLet's see…
You've caught {STR_VAR_2}…\pHm, it looks as if you're putting\nin an honest effort.\pWhen you manage to fill it some\nmore, come show me, please.

You've caught… {STR_VAR_2}!?
Now, this is impressive!\pThere's something I wanted to ask
of you, {PLAYER}.\pCome.
Follow me.

OAK: Ah, {PLAYER}!
You seem to be enjoying traveling.\pKnowing you, {PLAYER}, I can easily
imagine you going out to even more\lexotic locales.\pGood for you, good for you.
Hohoho.
TRAINER TIPS\pPress START to open the MENU!
Look, look!\pI copied what it said on one of\nthose TRAINER TIPS signs!
